instruction: Candid medium shot in a bright indoor room. On the left, the woman in the white sleeveless top (R3) stands with arms open wide, laughing. In the center, the man in the yellow t-shirt (R2) leans forward with arms outstretched to embrace her. In the foreground right, the little girl in the light long-sleeve shirt (R1) stands with her back to the camera, reaching her arm out. Bright natural light illuminates the scene, highlighting their joyful expressions.
elements: R2 leans forward with arms outstretched to embrace R3
R3 stands with arms open wide as the target/receiver of R2's embrace
R1 stands with her back to the camera and reaches an arm out toward the interaction
R2 is the active embracer while R3 is the open-armed receiver

questions.q: Is R2 the one leaning forward with arms outstretched to embrace R3, rather than R3 leaning forward to embrace R2?
questions.element: R2 actively leans forward to embrace R3

questions.q: Is R3 the open-armed target of R2's embrace, rather than R2 being the open-armed target of R3's embrace?
questions.element: R3 receives or welcomes R2's embrace

questions.q: Is R1 reaching an arm out from the foreground while R2 is the person moving forward to embrace R3, rather than R1 being the person embracing R3?
questions.element: R1 reaches out but R2 has the active embrace role toward R3

questions.q: Does R1 have her back to the camera while extending an arm toward the others?
questions.element: R1's body configuration is back-facing with an arm reaching out
